basic_profile.bio: I'm a 47-year-old jewelry enthusiast based in Seattle. By day, I work as a software engineer, but my true passion lies in collecting and learning about fine jewelry. I enjoy spending my evenings browsing various subreddits, learning about new hobbies, and sharing my knowledge with others. I'm married with two kids, and I love discussing parenting tips on RedditDads. My usual online hours are late evenings after the kids have gone to bed. I dislike misinformation, especially when it comes to valuable items such as jewelry.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have worked in the tech industry for over 20 years. My interest in jewelry started as a hobby, but over time, I've become quite knowledgeable through self-study and interacting with experts in the field. I often read industry publications and participate in online forums to stay updated.
